_provenance: EPCOR water + wastewater-treatment + sanitary-collection tariffs (residential + multi-res).
Source: docs/utility_cost_estimation_lens_methods.md SA-SB (verified against EPCOR rate pages).
Fixed daily charges keyed by meter size in mm; ONLY sizes verified for BOTH water and
sanitary are listed (15/25/100/300) - the meter-size bands in load_water.py use only these.
Public Fire Protection charge EXCLUDED from the model: only its 15mm rate is verified,
and inventing the larger-meter scaling would break the no-invented-numbers rule.
Volumetric blocks are [monthly_m3_upper_bound, rate_per_m3]; null bound = open-ended.
Residential blocks are inclining (per household); multi-res blocks are declining (per
building connection) - opposite shapes, Methods SA.
Rates reset each April 1 - re-pull before any production claim.
Everything computed from these is MODELED, not billed (SPEC_utilities.md Lens 2).
